visualCharacteristics: Full-viewport horizontal vehicle carousel (MG Cyberster, MG M9). Each slide: day + night car image, title, tagline, EXPLORE NOW + DOWNLOAD BROCHURE buttons. Optional first row with day/night background images. Left/right round arrow buttons; bottom-left day/night theme toggle switching images via data-theme attribute; bottom slider progress bar. Keyboard accessible, aria-live.
contentPattern: Optional leading row(s) with only images = day | night background. One row per vehicle: day car image (+ optional night car image) | richtext with title, tagline, first link = outlined CTA (EXPLORE NOW), further links = text links (DOWNLOAD BROCHURE).
